settings.name: lunar_prescribed_p4
settings.forcing: Uniform local 3 mm/h column ceiling, original seed flux and mass/dimension distribution, initially empty ice column. Prescribed mode shares the ceiling across native trial growth increments; reservoir modes add vapor up to that ceiling and liquid saturation.
settings.unmatched: Native evolving porous spheroid geometry, Bohm drag and constant ice efficiency 0.1; spherical injected shapes with matched mass and maximum dimension. Ballistic settling; no chipping. Native dry-air thermodynamic constants. 8 columns of weighted particles, not the custom finite individual-particle volume.

reading_rule: Same native binary and T,p,e path in all new forcing controls; the separately retained stronger-sticking reference uses its identified modified binary. Lunar/deep and Earth/shallow preserve gH. Crossed controls are imposed nonhydrostatic profiles with dynamics disabled. Water and seed flux are fixed except separately labeled sensitivities. Eight-column sampling errors exclude physical model error.
